## 📕 Improved Levels
A handy little QOL resource pack to help you correctly display larger enchantment and potion effect levels.

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/H2H118OP6T)

## Usage
> ### 🔢 Number format
> To start using your preferred number format, simply select either the Roman (XI) or Arabic (11) numeral version of the pack.
> ### ➕ Additional content
> If you want to see status effect levels in your inventory when they exceed 10, you can download the Status Effect Fix Fabric mod [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/status-effect-fix/). Since version 1.0.2, you no longer need this if you have it, as both versions of the pack are embedded now.
